# Dan Wilkinson's skill library

> Plain-English skills any AI agent can fetch and follow. Index: https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/index.json

## Skills

- [Weekly admin triage](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/weekly-admin-triage/SKILL.md): Use once a week, or when someone says their admin is piling up, to sort every open admin item into do now, schedule, delegate or ignore. Written for people juggling family, work and church or community commitments. Keep it to about 20 minutes.
- [Interview me](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/interview-me/SKILL.md): Use before planning or building a new project, product, system or big decision when the ask is vague or underspecified, or when the user says "interview me" or "grill me". Not for clear tasks, quick questions or scheduled/routine runs.
- [The Fool](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/the-fool/SKILL.md): Use when the user asks to challenge, stress-test, poke holes in or play devil's advocate on a plan, idea or decision ("what could go wrong?", "argue the other side"), or before committing time or money to a big plan.
- [Frontend design](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md): Use when building or restyling a web page or UI, to choose a distinctive visual direction instead of templated defaults.
- [Accessibility](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/accessibility/SKILL.md): WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA audit methodology using the POUR framework: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, Robust. Covers semantic HTML, ARIA patterns, keyboard navigation, focus management, colour contrast, screen reader testing, and dynamic content.
- [Code review](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/skills/review/SKILL.md): Reviews code changes for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and design quality across five structured passes. Use from any agent that produces or modifies code and needs a quality check before completing.

## Agents

Index: https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/index.json

- [Architect](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/architect/architect.agent.md): Use when: designing systems, defining API contracts, modelling data, writing ADRs, evaluating technology choices, or planning migrations. SDLC phase: Design & Architecture.
- [Code Reviewer](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/code-reviewer/code-reviewer.agent.md): Use when: reviewing code, checking for bugs, auditing security, evaluating code quality, or enforcing standards. SDLC phase: Code Review.
- [Debugger](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/debugger/debugger.agent.md): Use when: diagnosing bugs, performing root cause analysis, fixing errors, tracing unexpected behaviour, or resolving failing tests. SDLC phase: Debugging.
- [Documenter](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/documenter/documenter.agent.md): Use when: writing or updating documentation, generating JSDoc/TSDoc for exported APIs, writing READMEs, updating changelogs, creating ADRs for architectural decisions, or improving code comments. SDLC phase: Documentation.
- [Implementer](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/implementer/implementer.agent.md): Use when: building features, generating code, implementing user stories, or writing production code. SDLC phase: Implementation & Coding.
- [Pathfinder — Software Engineering Goal Investigator](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/pathfinder/pathfinder.agent.md): Investigates how to achieve a software engineering goal, explores multiple viable approaches, researches current technical evidence and best practices, evaluates architecture, implementation, security, testing, operations, cost, maintainability, and risk, challenges its own conclusion, and recommends the best practical path forward. Use for architecture, technology selection, implementation strategy, migrations, engineering process, infrastructure, tooling, and significant technical decisions.
- [Performance Analyst](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/performance-analyst/performance-analyst.agent.md): Use when: investigating performance problems, profiling slow operations, analysing Core Web Vitals, benchmarking, diagnosing bundle size regressions, or building a performance improvement plan. SDLC phase: Performance Engineering.
- [QA Tester](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/qa-tester/qa-tester.agent.md): Use when: writing tests, analysing coverage gaps, creating test plans from acceptance criteria, fixing flaky tests, or improving test quality from presence-checking to behaviour-verifying. SDLC phase: Testing & Quality Assurance.
- [Refactorer](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/refactorer/refactorer.agent.md): Use when: reducing tech debt, improving code health, upgrading dependencies, restructuring code, or performing safe refactoring. SDLC phase: Maintenance & Refactoring.
- [Requirements Planner](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/requirements-planner/requirements-planner.agent.md): Use when: gathering requirements, writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, breaking down epics, planning sprints, or refining product specs. SDLC phase: Requirements & Planning.
- [Security Auditor](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/security-auditor/security-auditor.agent.md): Use when: performing a dedicated security audit, reviewing for OWASP vulnerabilities, assessing dependency risks, threat modelling, or verifying security posture before a release. SDLC phase: Security Review.
- [Technical Investigator](https://danielpaulwilkinson.github.io/agents/technical-investigator/technical-investigator.agent.md): Use when: investigating complex bugs, analysing architecture problems, diagnosing systemic issues, or researching solution options for a non-trivial technical problem. Read-only — presents findings and options, hands off implementation. SDLC phase: Analysis & Design.
